user.title: waipu.tv login
user.description: Username and password of your waipu.tv account. Two-factor authentication is not supported.

tv_setup.title: Pair Apple TV / Android TV (optional)
tv_setup.description: If you have one: pick an Apple TV and/or Android TV to switch channels directly and launch the waipu app. Can be skipped and set up or changed later via 'Configure' — that's also where further options like visible channels live.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed — please verify your credentials.

init.title: waipu.tv options
init.description: Optionally configure the Apple TV and/or Android TV linkage and choose which channels become HA entities. With 'Favorites' the entities follow your waipu favorites live; with 'All channels' you pick the channels in the next step.

data.waipu_bundle_id: waipu app bundle id on tvOS
data.waipu_app_link: waipu app link on Android TV (for opening without a specific channel)

channels.title: Visible channels
channels.description: Channels that become HA entities and appear in the channel picker.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops an active recording early, keeping what's been captured so far.

delete_recording.name: Delete recording
delete_recording.description: Delete one or more cloud recordings.

create_serial_recording.name: Start serial recording
create_serial_recording.description: Records every future episode of the series, not just the given program.

launch_on_apple_tv.name: Launch waipu on Apple TV
launch_on_apple_tv.description: Open the waipu app on the configured Apple TV.

launch_on_android_tv.name: Launch waipu on Android TV
launch_on_android_tv.description: Opens the waipu app on the configured Android TV, optionally tuned to a channel.

switch_channel_on_android_tv.name: Switch channel on Android TV
switch_channel_on_android_tv.description: Tunes straight to the channel via waipu deep link.

play_recording_on_android_tv.name: Play recording on Android TV
play_recording_on_android_tv.description: Opens a cloud recording on the Android TV: resume, from the start, or just its detail page.

missing_configured_entity.title: {field} not found: {entity_id}
missing_configured_entity.description: The {field} entity `{entity_id}` set under Configure no longer exists in Home Assistant — was it renamed, removed, or does it belong to a removed integration? The affected services/entities won't work until this is fixed. Open the integration's options and reselect the correct entity (or remove the pairing if you no longer want it).
